meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. Sleman Et Al

rules.statement: The 'just valuation' of a house standing on land ordered to be sold under the Partition Ordinance would consider both the value of the materials and the value of the completed building in its relation to the land.
rules.supporting_quote: "The 'just valuation' of the house would be the cost of building a similar house. It is obvious that, if this is a proper test, both the value of the materials and the value of the completed building in its relation to the land would have had to be taken account of."
